title: 電子回路Ⅰ
subtitle: Electronic Circuits I
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn basic analog electronic circuits consisting of diode or transistor. (2) understand basic amplifiers with bipolar transistor. (3) understand design methods of analog electronic circuits. (4) learn circuits and mechanisms of FET or operational amplifier. (5) learn pulse circuits such as multi-vibrator.
advice: Course outline is shown as follows: 1. Fundamental electric circuit 2. Circuit consisting of diode 3. Mechanism of transistor 4. Amplifier using bipolar transistor 5. Grounding methods, equivalent circuit for signal 6. Thermal runaway, design of amplifier 7. DC bias circuit 8. Power amplifier, negative-feedback amplifier 9. Oscillator 10. Modulation and demodulation 11. FET 12. Operational amplifier 13. Pulse circuit
books: Textbooks:Electronic Circuits - Fundamentals & Applications - Reference books: Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Students should well understand "Electric Circuits I" and "Electric Circuits II." Questions are welcome during lecture.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain mechanisms of diode and transistor.
Be able to draw equivalent circuits of transistor amplifier.
Be able to calculate voltages and currents in each part for transistor amplifiers.
Be able to draw equivalent circuits of FET amplifier.
Be able to design circuits of operational amplifier.
Be able to explain pulse circuits such as differential circuit, integrating circuit and multi vibrator.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand and explain mechanism of diode and transistor, equivalent circuits. Also design transistor amplifier. (2) Explain FET amplifier and analyze its signal. (3) Explain mechanism of operational amplifier, and design application circuits. (4) Fully understand pulse circuits and explain them enough.
